tagline: One bag, one tree — the first 100 trees of the FounderHaus farm, planted with every bag of cacao tea sold at FounderHaus.
description_md:
FounderHaus Farm is a regenerative-farm partnership between FounderHaus and TrueSight DAO.

The first 100 bags of cacao tea consigned to FounderHaus each carry a ledger-registered QR code. The cacao is single-estate **Oscar's Farm, Bahia, 2024**; every bag sold books a **FounderHaus Tree Planting Pledge** (US$1.50) on the audited SunMint ledger — and funds one tree of the FounderHaus farm.

- **Batch:** 100 bags · QR batch 2024OSCAR_CT_20260820_1..100 · US$5 per bag
- **Trees:** 100 — the founding grove of the FounderHaus farm (Atlantic Forest biome, Santa Catarina)
- **Ledger:** AGL4 — every sale and every pledge is verifiable
- **Scan a bag** to see provenance and the pledge: [truesight.me/qr](https://truesight.me/qr/?id=2024OSCAR_CT_20260820_1)

The first trees were planted together on 21 August 2026 by Gary Teh, Paloma, Juliana Melo and Cristian Crispim at the FounderHaus volunteer site — the farm begins with these trees.
